mainEntity.name: When is structural steel needed instead of traditional wood framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structural steel is required whenever a project demands wide, open floor plans, heavy roof loads, or structural support that exceeds standard wood framing capacities. Commercial facilities, industrial warehouses, custom multi-story homes, and buildings with expansive clear-span entries frequently rely on steel framing. The decision factor usually comes down to architectural spans and weight distribution. If your design eliminates interior load-bearing walls or incorporates large overhead doors, an engineered steel frame or steel I-beam system provides the required load resistance without sagging over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Structural steel is needed for wide clear spans, heavy roof loads, or tall open spaces where wood framing lacks the strength to support the structure without interior columns.
